cards.name: Owala FreeSip (24 oz)
cards.price: $29.99 list for the 24 oz (NBC News, Yahoo, 2026) · under $25 on sale · 32 oz lists at $35–$40
cards.chip: Sip or chug · locks shut · cold for 24 h
cards.buy_if: you want to drink more water without thinking about it — desk, car, gym, school.
cards.skip_if: you want coffee in it (not for hot drinks) or a dishwasher-safe body.
cards.owners: Walmart: 4.7 out of 5 from about 29,700 ratings (24 oz Very, Very Black, October 2026). Praise: the lid. Complaints: clean the gasket or it molds; lock it or it leaks.

cards.buy_if: you want 40 ounces with a handle, and hot drinks too.

cards.name: Yeti Rambler 26 oz Straw Bottle
cards.buy_if: you want the most durable bottle and dishwasher-safe everything.
